author: National Geographic
description:
How were the pyramids built? In this MEGA episode compilation of Lost Treasures of Egypt from National Geographic, journey alongside leading archaeologists as they unlock the engineering marvels, hidden burial chambers, and secrets of the ancient world's most iconic monuments. What purpose did the pyramids serve? What new discoveries are being unearthed about ancient Egyptian engineering? Archaeologists venture into unexplored pyramids, excavate burial chambers, and reveal secrets of a forgotten dynasty of pharaohs: the Sun Kings. 

Featuring three, full episodes:

Lost Treasures of Egypt - Power of the Pyramids
As archaeologists journey into the heart of an unexplored pyramid, they unearth fresh evidence of the ancient Egyptians’ incredible engineering.

Lost Treasures of Egypt - Forgotten Pyramid
Archeologists excavate the unexplored burial chamber of an ancient pyramid in a quest to find the 4400-year-old king’s mummy and his treasures.
